integrity: The proof and checker are supplied. Finite tests do not constitute infinite proof. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Independent uniform factors in finite associative unital rings only; k>=1. Exact all-k formula and profile classification have self-review only. Two-factor semisimple special case and nilpotent square-matrix count are previously known. Equivalent prior all-k results remain a literature risk.
title: Complete nilpotent-product probability profiles of finite rings
